diagnostics.message: The explicit dependency from :output.iam_project_id to :resource.google_project_iam_binding.authoritative duplicates an existing dependency path: :output.iam_project_id depends on :resource.google_project.project, and the binding itself depends on that project. Removing this explicit dependency does not ensure the output waits for the binding, so this is not actually semantically redundant.

The :resource.google_project_iam_custom_role.roles resource can be created before APIs listed in :resource.google_project_service.project_services have finished enabling; IAM custom-role creation can fail until the relevant project APIs are enabled. Consider ordering custom role creation after service enablement.
